subject.title: Subagent Premature Announce Bug - Model-Specific Tool Call Handling Issues

question: May OpenClaw execute provider-specific tagged tool-call markers when they appear only inside thinking/reasoning blocks for affected OpenAI-compatible models?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the remaining behavior changes whether reasoning text can become executable tool calls, which is a product and security boundary rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Allow a narrow provider exception
options.body: Permit a provider-scoped parser only for documented affected providers/models, with allowed-tool validation, regression tests, and live provider proof.

options.title: Keep reasoning non-executable
options.body: Do not execute tool markers from thinking content; instead add diagnostics and guidance to switch to a supported model/provider path.

options.title: Defer until live repro
options.body: Require a fresh live Alibaba/ModelStudio reproduction before choosing the product and security direction.

recommendation.title: Allow a narrow provider exception
recommendation.body: Permit a provider-scoped parser only for documented affected providers/models, with allowed-tool validation, regression tests, and live provider proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the clearest recent current-main signal across provider/model routing and can route the security-boundary decision to the right area owners.
